segments.title: Opening & Best of 2023 Awards Planning
segments.notes: Case opens the abbreviated Friday broadcast, announces Best of 2023 award show for Sunday noon stream, solicits categories via Discord back-feed thread, and riffs on Black Santa t-shirts.

segments.title: Louisville Slushie Gate with Eugene Scrum
segments.notes: Case introduces Eugene Scrum (hired by Crum as replacement co-host, locked to two-year contract) to cover Louisville undercover officers throwing slushies at civilians 2018-2019; Scrum defends pranks, reveals expertise in gummy bears and beanie baby smuggling.

segments.title: Toilet Brush Debate: Adjustable Head vs Attachments
segments.notes: Entedaddy's requested debate: Munch argues for grit and fixed brushes, Crum argues adjustable heads reduce attachment complexity; poll ends in draw after graphic confusion.

segments.title: Pepito Therapy Session (Dog Therapist)
segments.notes: Pepito attends therapy as a dog patient with Dr. Chath's son (animal therapist wearing DJ Newsic sunglasses); discusses fireworks fear, Fiona as parent, subway subs, and pregnancy with a street dog.

segments.title: Dual Joe Rogan Holiday Recap & Plant Theory
segments.notes: Two Joe Rogans discuss holiday ice baths, slippers from Target, evolving from trees, photosynthesis as ideal diet, steak sashimi as Japanese espionage, General Tso as Trojan horse, and Jamie bleeding out from mask-making.

segments.title: Anyone But You Trailer & Sydney Sweeney Alien Conspiracy
segments.notes: Clementine Verne deconstructs Anyone But You trailer as horniness psy-op, identifies Blue Lives Matter flag as gray alien flag with blue laser beam, reveals Sydney Sweeney's cowboy-hat birthday party as alien gathering, cites cowboy hats = alien headgear per Get Out filmmaker.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Raid to Golden Boy FTW
segments.notes: Case thanks viewers, announces Sunday Best of 2023 stream, considers award names (Binnies, Creamies), raids Golden Boy FTW wishing happy holidays.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts a truncated Friday night broadcast debuting Eugene Scrum — Crum's hired replacement locked to a two-year contract — to cover the Louisville 'Slushie Gate' police scandal. Munch and Crum debate toilet brush attachments versus adjustable heads in a draw decided by graphic confusion. Pepito attends therapy as a dog patient, revealing a street dog pregnancy. Dual Joe Rogans espouse plant-based photosynthesis diets and General Tso espionage theory. Clementine Verne exposes the Sydney Sweeney film 'Anyone But You' as an alien horniness psy-op with Blue Lives Matter flags as gray alien laser beacons. The stream ends with a raid on Golden Boy FTW.
